title: Awesome TUIs
by: Justin Garrison and contributors, on GitHub
summary: A community-maintained list of more than 700 terminal apps and libraries in 13 sections, from dashboards, editors and Docker or Kubernetes front ends to games, plus TUI libraries grouped by language (Python, Go, C, C++, Java, .NET, Rust and others). Entries must be interactive, maintained and not just wrappers around tools like fzf; they arrive by pull request with one-line descriptions, and the maintainer says to run them at your own risk.
